mapper.select: select csm_group_no, case when sum(coalesce("pv_rep_amt", 0) + coalesce("lrc_ra_amt", 0) - coalesce("lrc_no_lc_amt", 0)) > 0 then sum(coalesce("pv_rep_amt", 0) + coalesce("lrc_ra_amt", 0) - coalesce("lrc_no_lc_amt", 0)) else 0 end as "lrc_lc_amt" from measure_platform.measure_cf_result_info where val_month = #{valMonth} group by csm_group_no

select csm_group_no, case when sum(coalesce("pv_rep_amt", 0) + coalesce("lrc_ra_amt", 0) - coalesce("lrc_no_lc_amt", 0)) > 0 then sum(coalesce("pv_rep_amt", 0) + coalesce("lrc_ra_amt", 0) - coalesce("lrc_no_lc_amt", 0)) else 0 end as "lrc_lc_change_amt" from measure_platform.measure_cf_result_info where val_month = #{valMonth} group by csm_group_no
